Cleartext is permitted at the platform level: the app itself refuses plain http
  in code to every host except the configured server. Only the system certificate
  store is trusted. There is no per-host exception, no debug override, no user
  certificate and no pinned key here.

  debug override, no user certificate and no pinned key here.
